reason: I've had sharp left-sided chest pain since last night.
diagnosis: Likely acute pericarditis, suggested by sharp left-sided chest pain that is worse lying flat and with deep inspiration, with relief when sitting up, plus associated dyspnea and lightheadedness.
keyPoints: Character of chest pain: pleuritic, positional, severity, radiation, onset and duration
Associated symptoms: dyspnea, lightheadedness, palpitations, syncope, fever or viral prodrome
Red flags for cardiac/PE causes: exertional pain, hemoptysis, unilateral leg swelling, immobilization, recent travel
Pericarditis/myocarditis clues: worse supine, better sitting forward, recent infection, chest rubbing history
Risk factors for ACS: smoking, family history of early MI, dyslipidemia, cocaine/stimulant use
Trauma and musculoskeletal triggers: recent heavy lifting, chest injury, reproducibility with movement/palpation
Past history/medications/allergies and substance use including tobacco, alcohol, marijuana
manner: worried, terse but cooperative, mildly breathless
